countries.reasoning: China is the leading producer of Indium Gallium Arsenide, supported by USGS and industry reports around 2022-2023; major production capacity and refining operations solidify this estimate with slight reporting lag.
South Korea is a significant producer due to its strong semiconductor industry; production data from national and industry sources are consistent but not fully public.
Japan maintains advanced semiconductor materials production, with consistent output reflected in trade and industry data; estimates based on available 2022-2023 info.
Taiwan's semiconductor and materials manufacturing contribute to production; estimates derived from industry analysis with moderate data availability.
